_provenance: Task-defining derived constants of dqi-hermitian, shared by grader.py and the circuits under circuits/. grader.py keeps its own inline first-principles derivation and asserts equality with this file at import. instance.py in this directory re-derives every value from first principles: field GF(64)=GF(2)[x]/(x^6+x^4+x^3+x+1); curve y^8+y=x^9, 512 affine points ordered lexicographically by (x,y); H = the 123x512 evaluation matrix of the L(150*Pinf) monomial basis, b-major; c = 3072 bits of counter-mode SHA-256 over c_tag, outside rowspace_F2(H); weight law = the principal-eigenvector DQI measure of Jordan et al. (2025), arXiv:2408.08292, at m=512, ell=47, p=28/64, quantized to a /2^16 grid by largest-remainder rounding. The sha256 digests are the provenance anchors that 'python grader.py' checks.
